list.title: Chats
list.searchPlaceholder: Search title, first prompt, project, id…
list.stateAllHint: Every chat, whatever it is doing
list.stateWorkingHint: A process is generating or running tools
list.stateWaitingHint: Stopped for a permission, a question or a plan
list.workersHint: The chats that carry out the tasks of an orchestration: their home is the orchestration board
list.internalHint: Housekeeping chats of Claudio itself (the planner, the auth check)
list.emptyFilteredBody: Nothing in this list matches the search or the filters in force.
list.emptyBody: Chats you start here, and the ones your agents have run in an imported project, appear in this list.
list.keysHint: j / k to move · Enter to open · x to select · / to search

bulk.deleteBody_one: Its transcript is deleted with it. This cannot be undone.
bulk.deleteBody_other: Their transcripts are deleted with them. This cannot be undone.
bulk.skipIntro_one: This one is left as it is:
bulk.skipIntro_other: These {{count}} are left as they are:
bulk.nothingTitle: None of these chats can be deleted now

new.title: New chat
new.subtitle: Starts a conversation with {{agent}} that Claudio keeps
new.promptHint: Drop or paste files onto the prompt to attach them.
new.agentHint: The model and the permission modes are the chosen agent's
new.modelHint: Alias or full model id. Empty = CLI default
new.modelFixed: {{agent}} keeps this model for the whole chat
new.accountHint: Which account the chat starts on
new.permissionModeHint: Can be changed while the chat works
new.askHere: Answer permission prompts, questions and plans from the panel (off: whatever would ask is denied)

examples.one: Read this project and tell me how it is laid out
examples.two: Find where the retries are handled and explain the policy
examples.three: Add a test for the case where the file is missing

runWorkflow.argsHint: Optional: handed to the script as `args` (text or JSON)
runWorkflow.modelHint: For the chat that launches it; the script can pick its own per agent
runWorkflow.intro: Scripts in the project's .claude/workflows/ and in your own. Running one starts a chat that launches it, so its prompts come to this panel.
runWorkflow.emptyBody: Save one from a chat with the Workflow tool, or write a script in .claude/workflows/.

limit.title: {{name}} reached its usage limit
limit.resetUnknown: The reset time is not known · last reading {{age}}
limit.waitingNote: Then your last message is sent again in this same chat.
limit.waitFailed: The wait could not be set
limit.stopWaitingFailed: The wait could not be stopped
limit.noteWait: Waiting sends your last message again in this chat once the limit resets.

composer.limit: Choose what to do with this chat to go on

refusal.busy: The chat is working. Interrupt it first, or wait for the turn to end.
refusal.waiting: The chat is waiting on a permission. Answer it first.
refusal.open: A compaction or a note is already being written.
refusal.read-only: This chat is held somewhere else and cannot be changed from here.
refusal.housekeeping: This is one of Claudio's own chats and is not compacted.
refusal.at-limit: The chat is at its usage limit. Compact it once the limit resets.
refusal.run: A flow or assistant run is using this chat right now.
refusal.no-history: The chat has not answered yet: there is nothing to compact.

panel.title: Context breakdown
panel.neverAnswered: No context yet: the chat has not answered.
panel.unknownWindow: The window is not known, so there is no share to draw.
panel.autoOn: {{agent}} compacts by itself when the window fills

unreported.no-process: The breakdown comes from {{agent}} while the conversation is open. This is the last count from the transcript.
unreported.unsupported: This version of {{agent}} does not report a breakdown. This is the last count from the transcript.
unreported.refused: {{agent}} did not give a breakdown. This is the last count from the transcript.
unreported.timeout: {{agent}} did not answer in time. This is the last count from the transcript.

panel.categoriesCaption: What fills the context window, by category
panel.outsideHint: Not counted: these schemas are loaded only when they are needed.
panel.mcpNone: No MCP server is loaded in this chat.
panel.exactBusy: The exact count waits until the chat is idle.

compactDialog.title: Compact the conversation
compactDialog.body: {{agent}} summarises the conversation and goes on from the summary. The messages stay visible here, but the agent no longer sees them in full. It is a turn paid like any other, about the size of the context now ({{size}}).
compactDialog.bodyNoSize: {{agent}} summarises the conversation and goes on from the summary. The messages stay visible here, but the agent no longer sees them in full. It is a turn paid like any other.
compactDialog.focusPlaceholder: the plan and the failing test
compactDialog.note: Save the summary as a session note

notes.title: Session notes
notes.empty: No notes yet. A compaction with the note switch on leaves one here.
notes.failed: The note could not be written.
notes.saveFailed: Could not keep the summary as a note

journal.title: Add the note to the journal
journal.hint: Every run of this project reads the journal. Read the text before you add it: anything that looked like a secret was masked.
journal.label: Journal entry

lessons.mineTitle: Look for lessons in this chat?
lessons.mineBody: A short one-shot run reads your corrections here. It costs at most {{cost}}, and nothing is kept until you approve it.
